title: Director of Predoctoral Endodontics Instructor in Restorative Dentistry and Biomaterials Sciences
bio: Dr. Morgan Celistan, MMSc23, lectures in Endodontics and was named HSDM's Director of Predoctoral endodontics in the summer of 2024. In this role, she spearheads the preclinical and clinical curricular development for predoctoral students. Celistan also contributes to the broader dental community by serving on the board of the Massachusetts Association of Endodontics, the Case Western Reserve University School of Dental Medicine Alumni Board of Directors, and the Foundation for Endodontics Board of Trustees.
